text:
sylvie: FYI opened a docs PR to add an "eval set" example and minimal sample payloads for model cards. Noticed the existing generate vs embed examples are ambiguous for quantized variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2890

matt: link — thanks. Quick question: are we including both curl + SDK examples?

sylvie: yes, adding curl + python SDK v3 snippet. Also adding a short migration note about why streaming won't behave the same on int4/quantized variants.

docs-bot: PR opened by sylvie in redwood-inference/docs (#2890) — labels: docs, needs-review

jenna: I can tidy the python SDK v3 snippet. Can you paste the minimal payload you have in mind?

sylvie: pasted below — want this tiny example that shows generate vs embedding payloads and includes a token-limit note.

sylvie: ```bash
# generate (curl)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"nebula3b-quant","input":"Summarize the release notes in one sentence","max_tokens":60}'

# embedding (curl)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"nebula3b-quant-embed","input":"Release notes v1.2"}'
```

samir: tiny nit — streaming is not supported on nebula3b-quant variants right now, so we should add a callout: "Streaming: not supported on quantized int4 variants — use float variants for streaming."

kevin: can we add a one-line compatibility matrix to the card and link to the model-catalog page? e.g., streaming: yes/no, embeddings: yes/no, long-context: yes/no. That avoids repeating text.

luis: I'll add the evalset reference and the regeneration note: "Eval set: evals/release/2026-03-model-cards" and include the bench link. Also add a quick example of token counting so folks can sanity-check unit costs.

jenna: updated the SDK snippet in the PR to v3 style and added a short `warnings` block for quantized variants. PTAL @matt @samir

matt: glanced — looks fine. One request: in the curl example please show `--compressed` and a short example payload that triggers the prefix-cache behavior so bench team can reproduce.

sylvie: added compressed and a prefix-cache example (short). Also added a small checklist in the PR description: 1) add matrix row on model-catalog, 2) add evalset link, 3) update streaming footnote, 4) add SDK snippet, 5) docs-review

docs-bot: label `docs:needs-review` -> `docs:reviewing` (assigned to jenna)

samir: pinging @bench-team for token counts and perf implications :eyes:

kevin: once bench approves, we'll need a follow-up doc to migrate any customers using `nebula3b` float -> quant variants; add rollout notes and rollback steps. I've created a GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/412

luis: quick QA note — make sure links are relative for internal site (e.g., "/model-catalog/nebula3b") so they work in staging. I fixed one absolute GH link in the PR.

sylvie: thanks — I pushed that change. Anything else blocking merge?

jenna: I'll do one more pass for copy and lgtm after bench signoff.

matt: ok from me once bench confirms token counts.

samir: bench gave :+1: — token checks match expected. small followup: add a regression alert snippet in the rollout docs showing how to tie an eval to SentEval (example id: eval-2026-03-20-07).

sylvie: perfect. moving PR -> ready to merge after jenna lgtm. thanks everyone :tada:
